comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. The calc language's built-in functions, operators and constants, shown in the app's function reference. tests/reference.rs evaluates every example (each line in turn, unit-aware) and checks that the last line's result contains `result`, and that every built-in name the parser knows is listed here. Entries with `available: false` parse but don't evaluate yet.

entries.name: abs
entries.summary: Absolute value; keeps the unit. Also written |x|. Units inside an expression are quoted: 'm'.

entries.name: roundn
entries.summary: Round to a format: "f2" is 2 decimal places, "r3" is 3 significant digits. Keeps the unit.

entries.name: roundSig
entries.summary: x rounded to n significant digits (the same as roundn(x, "rn")).

entries.name: floor
entries.summary: The largest integer not above x.

entries.name: ceil
entries.summary: The smallest integer not below x.

entries.name: mod
entries.summary: Floored modulo, a − b·⌊a/b⌋: the sign of b (as Excel's MOD). The arguments share a unit. Also an operator: a mod b.

entries.name: rem
entries.summary: Remainder of truncated division: the sign of a. The arguments share a unit.

entries.name: gcd
entries.summary: Greatest common divisor of two integers.
entries.caution: Doesn't check units yet: gcd(12 'm', 18 's') gives 6 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: sqrt
entries.summary: Square root; halves the unit's powers (√(4 m²) is 2 m). Type sqrt and it becomes √.

entries.name: hypot
entries.summary: √(a² + b² + …); the arguments share a unit.

entries.name: binomial
entries.summary: The binomial coefficient, n choose k.

entries.name: gamma
entries.summary: The gamma function Γ(x); also written Γ(x).

entries.name: sin
entries.summary: Sine. A plain number is in radians; an angle with a unit (30°, 0.5 rad) is converted.

entries.name: atan2
entries.summary: The angle of the point (x, y), in radians, in the right quadrant. The arguments share a unit.
entries.caution: Doesn't check units yet: atan2(1 'm', 1 's') gives a result instead of an error (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: acot
entries.summary: Inverse cotangent, atan(1/x); acot(0) is π/2.

entries.name: sind
entries.summary: Sine of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: cosd
entries.summary: Cosine of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: tand
entries.summary: Tangent of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: secd
entries.summary: Secant of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: cscd
entries.summary: Cosecant of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: cotd
entries.summary: Cotangent of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: logn
entries.summary: Logarithm of x to base b.

entries.name: sum
entries.summary: Sum of the arguments, or of a vector's elements. The arguments share a unit.
entries.caution: Of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed); sum(A, 1) and sum(A, 2) work.

entries.name: product
entries.summary: Product of the arguments or of a vector's elements.
entries.caution: The unit is wrong: product(2 'm', 3 'm') gives 6 m, not 6 m²; of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: mean
entries.caution: Of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: median
entries.summary: The middle value, or the mean of the two middle values.

entries.name: min
entries.summary: Smallest argument or element; the arguments share a unit.
entries.caution: Of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: max
entries.caution: Of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: range
entries.caution: Of a matrix, gives 0 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: variance
entries.summary: Sample variance (n − 1, as Excel's VAR.S), in the square of the arguments' unit.

entries.name: stddev
entries.summary: Sample standard deviation (n − 1, as Excel's STDEV.S).

entries.name: rand
entries.summary: Uniform random numbers in [0, 1): one, a column vector of n, or an m × n matrix. A new value each time the document is calculated.

entries.name: lerp
entries.summary: Linear interpolation: the y at x on the polyline through the points (xs, ys). xs must increase.

entries.name: transpose
entries.summary: Rows become columns. Also written Aᵀ.

entries.name: length
entries.summary: Number of elements of a vector or matrix, or characters of a string.

entries.name: hcat
entries.summary: Join side by side (also written a & b).

entries.name: zeros
entries.summary: An m × n matrix of zeros.
entries.caution: zeros(m, 1) with m > 1 gives one element, not m (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: ones
entries.summary: An m × n matrix of ones.
entries.caution: ones(m, 1) with m > 1 gives one element, not m (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.name: findmax
entries.summary: The largest element and its index (from 1): unpack with m, i = findmax(v) = !

entries.name: findfirst
entries.summary: Index (from 1) of the first true element of a vector of booleans; 0 if none.

entries.name: trace
entries.summary: Sum of a square matrix's diagonal.

entries.name: dataframe
entries.summary: A data frame from vectors, one per column. Literal frames are usually written as a table between double backticks (see Help).

entries.name: matrix2table
entries.summary: A data frame from a matrix, with column names (and optional row names) given as vectors of strings.

entries.name: string
entries.summary: A number as text in a format ("f2": 2 decimal places, "r3": 3 significant digits).

entries.name: Char
entries.summary: The character with Unicode code point n.

entries.name: count
entries.summary: How many times pattern occurs in s.

entries.name: today
entries.summary: Today's date (as of the latest calculation).

entries.name: savedate
entries.summary: The date the document was last saved.
entries.note: Cruncha has no save date: every change is a version. Use the History tab.

entries.name: real
entries.summary: Real part. j is the imaginary unit (unless you define j).

entries.name: isnan
entries.summary: true if x is not a number.

entries.name: fetch
entries.summary: Load a data frame from a URL.
entries.note: Calcs don't reach the network. Load data in a Python cell.

entries.name: startSvg
entries.note: Draw with a Python cell (Plotly or matplotlib).

entries.summary: Add and subtract; units must be compatible and are converted.

entries.signature: a b, a · b, a × b
entries.summary: Multiply. A space between factors multiplies too; × of two 3-vectors is the cross product.
entries.caution: The cross product gives [] (ADR-0022, to be fixed). Compute it by components for now.

entries.summary: Divide. It takes the run of factors just before it: w L^2 / 8 is w·(L²/8).

entries.caution: A two-element vector squared is read as a complex number: [2, 3]^2 gives 4 + j 9 (ADR-0022, to be fixed).

entries.signature: a < b, a ≤ b, a ≥ b, a ≠ b
entries.summary: Comparisons, for @test and conditions. Type <= for ≤, >= for ≥, != for ≠.

entries.name: and or xor ¬
entries.signature: p and q, p or q, ¬p

entries.summary: Join strings, or vectors side by side.

entries.name: @test
entries.summary: A pass/fail check, listed on the report's cover as OK or NOT OK.

entries.name: e
entries.summary: Euler's number (unless you define e, e.g. as an eccentricity).

entries.name: j
entries.summary: The imaginary unit (unless you define j).
